title: Compactness for pseudo-differential and Toeplitz operators on modulation spaces
summary: We deduce various norm equivalences, and convolution estimates for the modulation space $M^{\sharp ,q}_{(ω)}$ consisting of all $f\in M^{\infty ,q}_{(ω)}$ such that $|V_φf \cdot ω|$ satisfies a mild vanishing condition at infinity. We prove that $M^{\sharp ,q}_{(ω)}$ is the completion of the Gelfand-Shilov space $Σ_1$ under the $M^{\infty ,q}_{(ω)}$ norm. We use these results to deduce compactness for $Ψ$DO $\op (\mathfrak a )$, with $\mathfrak a \in M^{\sharp ,q}_{(ω)}$, $0<q\le 1$, when acting on a broad family of modulation spaces.
